player_prompt.intro:
Doe bies Speler {player_id} in **Ultiem Tic Tac Toe**.
Gief dien zet op as **[macro  micro]** (twie getalle 0-8):
• *macro*  = in welk mini-bord doe speul
• *micro* = in welk veld binne dat mini-bord
Veurbeeld `[7 8]` ➜ plaots dien teike in mini-bord 7, veld 8, en
dwing dien taegenstander óm in mini-bord 8 te speule.

Doe bies `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: De sjpelling mót in de vorm [macro micro] zeen mèt nummers 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Elke indexe moatte wêze tusken 0 en 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: De micro_board, rij of kol is oet bereik.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: De speler moot in 't volgende micro-bordje speule.

game_action.played: Speler {player_id} haet gespeeld in microbord {macro_idx}, cel {micro_idx} (riek {row}, kolom {col}). Speler {opponent_id} móts noe gespelen in {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Speler {player_id} wint Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
